extraction_notes: Main article provides most quantitative catalytic results in Figure 3 and refers to Table S7 / SI for fuller data; SI was not included in the prompt. Figure 3 conversion/selectivity bars and the long-term stability plot are present but not extracted because exact point values are not printed and the plotted values are too small/overlaid for reliable full extraction. Approximate STY values were read only from clearly labelled points in Figure 3b/e; printed text values at 280 °C were used where available and take precedence over plot estimates. Literature-comparison statements in the Introduction and references were not extracted.
